criteria.AC-01: The actual UBI9.8-derived target reports full RPM NEVRAs and custom payload source/manifest/content/hash/version/configuration/function through strict SSH/Ansible, bound to the candidate/image/Run.
criteria.AC-02: Actual absent optional openssh-clients, controlled wrong-version expectation and unsupported OS applicability retain explicit failed/unverified rows without repairing the target to pass.
criteria.AC-03: Evidence names the UBI9.8-derived container userland and separate shared-host kernel limits; it does not claim a RHEL VM installation, boot test, scanner/STIG result or production eligibility.

limits: No VM, ISO boot/install, scanner/STIG support or production acceptance.
Negative harness pass preserves the failed underlying operation.

Shared host kernel is not an installed RHEL kernel. UBI-only AUDIT_WRITE permits owned authentication audit records in the shared kernel audit log; ordinary Ubuntu retains its original three capabilities.
No AUDIT_READ, AUDIT_CONTROL, KILL, PAM or host audit-setting change is established.
Shared daemon pull/commit has admitted overhead, not an operation-specific hard cgroup cap.
Storage checks are samples, not quotas or reserved space.
Private state, raw captures, keys and Terraform evidence remain outside Git.
Engineering review, publication, hosted CI and owner acceptance are separate facts.

ordinary_ubuntu_regression.scope: Unchanged stock Ubuntu functional path; not a candidate or RPM installation.
